plan.notes: Source: https://www.purdue.edu/science/archive/docs/current-students/majors/computer-science-f24-dpg1.pdf (official Purdue University College of Science / Department of Computer Science '2024-2025 Computer Science Degree Progression Guide'). Catalog year: 2024-2025 -- the DPG's own disclaimer names the 2024-2025 Purdue West Lafayette catalog as the source for academic and programmatic requirements (students entering Fall 2024 / Spring 2025 / Summer 2025). Program's true catalog name: 'Computer Science, BS' (College of Science, West Lafayette). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the DPG's 8-semester progression table, the '2024-25 Computer Science Major Science Courses' list, and the '2024-25 Computer Science Major Tracks and Course Options' list; every course code, title, credit value, and prerequisite copied verbatim from the DPG (titles for MA 16500/16600/27101/35100, STAT 35000/51100, and CS 39100 cross-checked against official catalog.purdue.edu program pages). Transcription method: read the official PDF text via browser, mapped the two-column Fall/Spring layout term by term, and validated each term's credit range against the DPG's printed totals (all 8 terms match exactly). Caveats: (1) The live 2025-2026 catalog.purdue.edu 'Computer Science, BS' program page returned access-denied to the fetcher on 2026-09-30 and was not retried, so this plan uses the newest fully verifiable official source, the 2024-2025 DPG -- catalog_year is recorded honestly as 2024-2025. (2) DPG credit ranges are instantiated canonically to sum to exactly 120: 4-credit Calculus options (MA 16500/16600), 4-credit Multivariate Calculus (MA 26100), Science Core Options at 3 cr, free electives sized 1-3 cr per the DPG; choosing 5-credit calculus variants adds credits above 120. (3) CS 19300, CS 29100, and CS 39100 are recommended seminars, NOT degree requirements (DPG footnotes); they occupy free-elective credits here exactly as the DPG places them. (4) Track slots are student choice -- the student must declare at least one CS track; all track courses and their prerequisites require a grade of C or better. (5) 2.0 major and graduation GPA required; minimum 120 credits; 32 credits at 30000+ level taken at Purdue.
